expectation.text: The trackpad should behave as it does on macOS: content follows the fingers when scrolling, three fingers sideways moves between workspaces, three fingers up shows every workspace with its windows (as Mission Control does) and lets the user click a window to go to it, and a four-finger pinch opens the app grid (as Launchpad does). It should keep working across Hyprland updates.

payload.observed: On Omarchy 4.5 with Hyprland 0.56.2 none of this is on by default: scrolling is not natural, no gestures are bound, and there is no window overview. Scrolling, the workspace swipe and the app grid pinch need only a few lines in the user's Hyprland input file, the last one by calling the dock's built-in app grid. The overview needs more: the hyprexpo compositor plugin was removed from the official hyprland-plugins repository on 2026-05-12 (commit 3aa21f2, 'all: drop unmaintained plugins') and is absent from the revision that repository pins for Hyprland 0.56.2, so a user-owned Omarchy shell plugin built on Quickshell provides it instead, without compiling anything against Hyprland. This is a personal preference, not behaviour Omarchy promised.
payload.title: Mac-style trackpad gestures for Omarchy: natural scroll, workspace swipe, window overview and app grid pinch
